lines: After repelling the pursuing ninja――
While nursing her deep wound, Amane had proceeded down the mountain road, and soon arrived at her target location.
Amane
「I made it, huh......?」
A small estate, standing deserted and hidden in the mountains of Gosha.
It was the 『secondary home』 that Fuuma Danjou used to use――
A hidden mansion for the head of the Fuuma family.
Amane
「.........Danjou-sama.」
Warm feelings seeped into Amane's heart, which had been dead for years now.
When Fuuma Danjou was alive and well, this had been his secret meeting place.
Centred around him, the fearsome warriors of the Fuuma had secretly assembled, and passionately discussed the future that they envisioned for the clan.
They had all been enamoured with Danjou's mettle as head of the family, and had sympathized with the ideals he spoke about.
However――
Most of them had been killed in the revolt against Gosha, and there were barely any left alive.
They had fallen in battle, with the exception of Amane, who was steward to the head family.
Amane
Shaking off that sentimentality, she headed for the door.
Here, she should be able to rest her body――
Amane
Amane set foot in the villa.
However, there was the presence of someone there.
Amane
「As I thought, this is......?」
When she entered the living room, the curtains and sliding shutters were open.
There were clearly signs that someone had visited.
Why, when there shouldn't have been anybody who used it after Danjou's death......?
Amane
（This presence is...... coming from the basement library?）
Amane thought, suspiciously, as she concealed her presence and headed for the library.
And when she did, there was――
Amane
Forgetting to even suppress her presence, Amane stood motionless in the entrance of the library.
「Eh?! C-Could it be...... Amane-san......?」
Right there was a boy, whom even Amane recognized just from a faint image of him as a child――Danjou's son and heir, Fuuma Kotarou.
